annotation.title_clean: Republic of Ghana National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2035
annotation.title_en: Republic of Ghana National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2035
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations (Ghana)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's 2025-2035 national AI strategy sets a vision of an AI-powered society through eight pillars: education, youth skills, infrastructure, data governance, ecosystem, sectoral adoption, applied research and public-sector adoption. It proposes a Responsible AI Authority and aligns with the UNESCO AI ethics Recommendation. No robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eight pillars: AI education, youth jobs, digital infrastructure, data governance, ecosystem, sector adoption, research, public sector
Establish an independent Responsible AI Authority to drive implementation and ethical oversight
Aligned with UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Create a National AI Fund and National Deep Science Institute
Targets include 40% gender participation in AI fellowships and projected GDP contribution of 500 billion cedis by 2035
